meta.quotes: Democratic contract only. quotes.D.bid/ask[i] = best YES quote observed at the END of the candle ending at window[0] + (i+1)*60; the book in the candle as observed, so bid 0 or ask 1 = one-sided book (no two-sided quote); null = no candle that minute (Kalshi omits quiet minutes: the last observed book stands) or after trading close. last[i] = last trade inside that minute
meta.trades: [exact execution time UTC s, 0 = D contract / 1 = R contract, taker bought YES = 1 / NO = 0, YES price $, contracts]
meta.marks: close_ts = Kalshi trading close (close_time); settle_ts = Kalshi settlement (settlement_ts). Neither is a media call
meta.sides: D/R contract found by Kalshi political_party id, else ticker suffix -D/-R
